settings.title: OMR Settings · EZ Mark
settings.intro: Fine-tune how answer sheets are read and how mark sheets are printed. Change a value on the left and the sample on the right shows what changes and how.
settings.reset_confirm: Reset all OMR settings back to their default values?

detection.desc: Decides how a pencil mark is judged as filled in or left blank when scans are processed.
detection.preset_help: Pick a ready-made setting, or choose “Adjust myself” to set each value by hand.
detection.preset_locked: These values follow the quick setting above. Choose “Adjust myself” to edit them.
detection.mark_threshold_help: A bubble filled at least this much counts as marked. Higher means students must fill bubbles more firmly to be detected.
detection.weak_threshold_help: If a bubble is filled less than this, it is treated as left blank.
detection.min_gap_help: If the darkest bubble only barely beats the next one, the student may have hesitated, so it is flagged for review.
detection.dark_pixel_help: Pixels darker than this are counted as part of the mark. Lower counts only near-black; higher also counts faint dots (0–255).
detection.drift_help: If the scanned paper is slightly shifted, bubbles are searched for within this distance so marks are still read.

print.desc: Adjust how light the bubbles, lines and numbers are printed. A higher value prints lighter — easier for the scanner to read pencil marks; a lower value prints darker — easier for people to see.
print.bubble_outline_help: How light the round outline students fill in is printed. Higher = lighter.
print.grid_line_help: How light the table rules and divider lines are printed. Higher = lighter.
print.choice_label_help: How light the numbers (1, 2, 3…) inside the bubbles are printed. Higher = lighter.

preview.detection_desc: The bar shows how a mark is judged by how much it is filled in. Changing the settings moves the boundaries.
preview.gap_title: When two bubbles are both dark
preview.gap_demo: Example: darkest {top}% / next {second}% → difference {diff}%. Threshold is {gap}%, so → {verdict}
preview.darkness_desc: Shades darker than the cutoff are counted as part of the mark.
preview.drift_desc: Even if the paper shifts by about {mm}mm, the bubble is still found within the dashed area.
preview.print_desc: A rough guide to how dark the printed bubbles and lines will be.
